# LIVE ledger. Cadence: EVENT-DRIVEN (one row per DARK-recipient action: dispatch, doorbelled or not — the non-doorbelled rows are the MISS counter denominator; declared 2026-09-17).
# ONE ROW PER DARK-RECIPIENT `action:` DISPATCH — NOT only the doorbelled ones. Without the non-doorbelled rows the miss counter has no denominator.
# The five ruled fields: desk · referent · doorbelled · disposition · drained. The other four are bookkeeping that make MISS computable.

# referent: the named clock + its date (DOCKET-<n> / GATES-<id> / EXPIRY-<date> / OPEN-<date>), or CADENCE:p75=<n>d/dark=<d>d(nr,w90+,n=<gaps>) (leg 3b, v0.22 SELF-NORMALISING form from 2026-09-01; rows before that used CADENCE:<median-gap>d under the RETIRED ≥7d form — a THIRD population, never pooled) or CADENCE:n<8 (leg 3b not computable), or NONE (leg 3 failed).
# gate: which legs passed, dot-joined (P0.L1.L2.L3a) — or the first leg that failed (L3-FAIL). Case-normalise `action`/`ACTION` before counting (rider R1).
# doorbelled: YES|NO. disposition: SPAWNED|DECLINED|DEFERRED|NA. drained: items the touch actually cleared (NA if not spawned).
# consumed_at: filled retro when the item is consumed. MISS is computed, never typed: referent date < consumed_at.
# Age basis is named on every emitted count (rider R2). v1 (pre-2026-08-23) and v2 doorbells are TWO POPULATIONS — do not pool them in the 8/28 soak.

# 🔴 EXEMPT-DESK CAVEAT (added 2026-09-11, SPEC v0.24 §3.5.8): for a PULL_COMPLETE-exempt recipient (CARL/RED/PROME/TERRY) a disposition of SPAWNED is NOT evidence the item was reached. The doorbell remedy's drain unit is the INBOX, which for an exempt desk is empty BY CONSTRUCTION, so `drained` counts inbox items unrelated to the dispatched signal.
